fusions.name: Descending Weight
fusions.desc: The whole swarm drops on one enemy as a single weight, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Crops Laid Flat
fusions.desc: The swarm beats down on every enemy within 2 tiles of you, dealing 4 damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave them [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Mass
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. For 4 seconds after you use it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Ground to Chaff
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
